author: delegate-gp[bot]
title: Add Stripe checkout fixture and outreach admin-action fixture endpoints
body:
## Why

Playwright E2E specs targeting preview environments had no way to:

1. **Deliver a signed `checkout.session.completed` event** — preview environments have no public webhook target, so Stripe's real signed delivery can't reach them. The new `POST /v1/test-fixtures/vendor-mocks/stripe/events` endpoint retrieves a real test-mode checkout session, wraps it in a synthetic event envelope, and calls `PaymentEventsService.handleEvent` in-process — no HTTP, no signature verification, but the same handler the live webhook hits.

2. **Apply CAS admin actions without admin credentials** — `cas.approve` and `results.upload` previously required the `AdminOrM2MGuard`, which Playwright specs can't satisfy with a test-user session. The new `POST /v1/test-fixtures/vendor-mocks/outreach/:id/admin-actions` endpoint runs those actions scoped to the owning test user.

Both endpoints are 404 outside non-prod deploys and 403 for non-test users, matching the rest of the vendor-mock surface.

`outreach.completion` is also added to the `runJob` allowlist so Playwright specs can trigger the Peerly status-sync sweep on demand.

## What changed

- **contracts**: `DeliverStripeEventRequest/Response` and `AdminOutreachActionRequest/Response` schemas
- **StripeService**: explicit `Promise<Stripe.Checkout.Session>` return type on the existing `retrieveCheckoutSession` (previously inferred as `Stripe.Response<Session>`, which breaks test mocking)
- **OutreachCompletionService**: `runCompletion()` — lock-free entry point for the `runJob` allowlist (mirrors `OutreachRobocallCompletionService` pattern)
- **OutreachModule**: exports `OutreachCompletionService`, `OutreachSmsAdminService`, `OutreachResultsAdminService` so `TestFixturesModule` can inject them
- **TestFixturesModule**: imports `StripeModule`
- **TestFixturesVendorMocksController**: two new POST routes
- **TestFixturesService**: `deliverStripeEvent` and `applyOutreachAdminAction` implementations
- **vendor-mocks.helper.ts**: `deliverStripeEvent` and `adminAction` Playwright helpers
- **Route test**: 5 cases for the Stripe fixture route (delivered status, event shape, session retrieval, 404 in prod, 403 for non-test user)

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> New endpoints invoke payment fulfillment and CAS/results admin paths without Stripe signature verification or admin guards, though they are gated to non-prod deploys and (for Stripe) test users only.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds **non-prod vendor-mock fixtures** so Playwright can exercise preview flows that normally depend on Stripe webhooks or staff admin APIs.
> 
> **Stripe:** `POST .../vendor-mocks/stripe/events` loads a real test-mode checkout session, wraps it as `checkout.session.completed`, and calls `PaymentEventsService.handleEvent` in-process (no public webhook). Contracts + route tests cover response shape, prod **404**, and non-test-user **403**.
> 
> **Outreach admin:** `POST .../vendor-mocks/outreach/:id/admin-actions` lets the owning test user run `cas.approve` or `results.upload` (CSV payload) via the same services as the admin console, with outreach ownership checks.
> 
> Also wires **`outreach.completion`** into the test-user `runJob` allowlist via a lock-free `OutreachCompletionService.runCompletion()`, exports the needed outreach services from `OutreachModule`, and adds Playwright helpers `deliverStripeEvent` / `adminAction`. `StripeService.retrieveCheckoutSession` now returns an explicit `Promise<Stripe.Checkout.Session>` for test mocking.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 5faf9fa1b55aa017cc63e17db52a09a49e907c79. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->

+  // Exposed for TestFixturesService's run-job allowlist, so the completion

+  async runCompletion(): Promise<void> {
+    const now = new Date()
+    const candidates = await this.model.findMany({
+      where: {
+        projectId: { not: null },
+        AND: [
+          {
+            OR: [
+              { status: null },
+              { status: OutreachStatus.pending },
+              { status: OutreachStatus.in_progress },
+            ],
+          },
+          {
+            OR: [
+              {
+                date: { gte: subDays(now, OUTREACH_COMPLETION_MAX_AGE_DAYS) },
+              },
+              {
+                AND: [
+                  { date: null },
+                  {
+                    createdAt: {
+                      gte: subDays(now, OUTREACH_COMPLETION_MAX_AGE_DAYS),
+                    },
+                  },
+                ],
+              },
+            ],
+          },
+        ],
+      },
+    })
+
+    for (const outreach of candidates) {
+      if (!outreach.projectId) {
+        continue
+      }
+      try {
+        await this.syncOutreachStatus(outreach, outreach.projectId, now)
+      } catch (err) {
+        this.logger.warn(
+          { err, outreachId: outreach.id, projectId: outreach.projectId },
+          '[Outreach Completion] Peerly job status check failed; will retry next sweep',
+        )
+      }
+    }
+  }

@@ -0,0 +1,136 @@
+import { PaymentEventsService } from '@/payments/services/paymentEventsService'
+import { StripeService } from '@/vendors/stripe/services/stripe.service'
+import { useTestService } from '@/test-service'
+import Stripe from 'stripe'
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+
+// Route-level coverage for POST /v1/test-fixtures/vendor-mocks/stripe/events.
+// The fixture endpoint retrieves a checkout session from Stripe, wraps it in a
+// Stripe.Event, and calls PaymentEventsService.handleEvent in-process so
+// Playwright specs can deliver signed checkout.session.completed events to a
+// preview environment without a public Stripe webhook target.
+//
+// The test verifies the plumbing — right event type delivered to handleEvent,
+// correct response shape — rather than re-testing payment-handler business
+// logic, which paymentEvents.cancellation.routes.test.ts already covers.
+
+const { envNonProd } = vi.hoisted(() => ({ envNonProd: { value: true } }))
+vi.mock('@/shared/util/appEnvironment.util', async (importOriginal) => {
+  const actual =
+    await importOriginal<typeof import('@/shared/util/appEnvironment.util')>()
+  return {
+    ...actual,
+    get IS_NON_PROD_DEPLOY() {
+      return envNonProd.value
+    },
+  }
+})
+
+const service = useTestService()
+
+const FIXTURE_ROUTE = '/v1/test-fixtures/vendor-mocks/stripe/events'
+const FAKE_SESSION_ID = 'cs_test_fixture_abc123'
+
+// A minimal checkout.session.completed session object whose shape satisfies
+// the handler's mode-dispatch (it just reads session.mode and routes).
+const fakeSession = {
+  id: FAKE_SESSION_ID,
+  object: 'checkout.session',
+  mode: 'payment',
+  payment_status: 'paid',
+  status: 'complete',
+  metadata: { userId: String(123) },
+  customer: null,
+  subscription: null,
+  amount_total: 5000,
+  currency: 'usd',
+} as unknown as Stripe.Checkout.Session
+
+describe('POST /v1/test-fixtures/vendor-mocks/stripe/events', () => {
+  let handleEvent: ReturnType<typeof vi.spyOn>
+
+  beforeEach(async () => {
+    envNonProd.value = true
+
+    await service.prisma.user.update({
+      where: { id: service.user.id },
+      data: { email: 'qa-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000@goodparty.org' },
+    })
+
+    vi.spyOn(
+      service.app.get(StripeService),
+      'retrieveCheckoutSession',
+    ).mockResolvedValue(fakeSession)
+
+    handleEvent = vi
+      .spyOn(
+        service.app.get(PaymentEventsService, { strict: false }),
+        'handleEvent',
+      )
+      .mockResolvedValue(undefined)
+  })
+
+  it('delivers a checkout.session.completed event and returns delivered status', async () => {
+    const res = await service.client.post(FIXTURE_ROUTE, {
+      type: 'checkout.session.completed',
+      sessionId: FAKE_SESSION_ID,
+    })
+
+    expect(res.status).toBe(201)
+    expect(res.data).toMatchObject({
+      status: 'delivered',
+      eventId: expect.stringMatching(/^evt_fixture_/),
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('calls PaymentEventsService.handleEvent with checkout.session.completed', async () => {
+    await service.client.post(FIXTURE_ROUTE, {
+      type: 'checkout.session.completed',
+      sessionId: FAKE_SESSION_ID,
+    })
+
+    expect(handleEvent).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
+    const [event] = handleEvent.mock.calls[0]
+    expect((event as Stripe.Event).type).toBe('checkout.session.completed')
+    expect((event as Stripe.CheckoutSessionCompletedEvent).data.object.id).toBe(
+      FAKE_SESSION_ID,
+    )
+  })
+
+  it('retrieves the session by sessionId', async () => {
+    const retrieveSpy = vi.spyOn(
+      service.app.get(StripeService),
+      'retrieveCheckoutSession',
+    )
+
+    await service.client.post(FIXTURE_ROUTE, {
+      type: 'checkout.session.completed',
+      sessionId: FAKE_SESSION_ID,
+    })
+
+    expect(retrieveSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(FAKE_SESSION_ID)
+  })
+
+  it('returns 404 outside non-prod deploys', async () => {
+    envNonProd.value = false
+    const res = await service.client.post(
+      FIXTURE_ROUTE,
+      { type: 'checkout.session.completed', sessionId: FAKE_SESSION_ID },
+      { validateStatus: () => true },
+    )
+    expect(res.status).toBe(404)
+  })
+
+  it('returns 403 for a non-test user', async () => {
+    await service.prisma.user.update({
+      where: { id: service.user.id },
+      data: { email: 'notatest@example.com' },
+    })
+    const res = await service.client.post(
+      FIXTURE_ROUTE,
+      { type: 'checkout.session.completed', sessionId: FAKE_SESSION_ID },
+      { validateStatus: () => true },
+    )
+    expect(res.status).toBe(403)
+  })
+})
